t: The Vim-AI Endosymbiosis: Reclaiming Humanity in the Age of Fragmentation
s: This article proposes Vim and a 'one text file for life' as a foundational methodology, mirroring Julia Cameron's Morning Pages, to transition from cognitive struggle (Yang) to intuitive mastery (Yin). This practice enables human-AI endosymbiosis, reclaiming humanity by mastering the bedrock of all technology: plain text files.
sub: Julia Cameron's Morning Pages: stages of intuitive flow
Vim mastery as spiritual practice: Yang-to-Yin cognitive shift
Text files as foundational technology bedrock
